newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket-Sri Lanka v Pakistan Independence Cup toss/teams.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Sri Lanka v Pakistan Independence Cup toss/teams.

text.p: Sri Lanka captain Arjuna Ranatunga won the toss and elected to bat in the first match of the best-of-three finals against Pakistan in Independence Cup on Saturday.
Pakistan brought in medium-pacer Abdul Razzak in place of seamer Azhar Mahmood while Sri Lanka named seamer Duleep Liyanage in place of fellow seamer Chaminda Vaas.
The second match is scheduled for Calcutta next Tuesday and, if required, a third game will be played at the same venue on Wednesday.
Pakistan - Rameez Raja (captain), Saeed Anwar, Shahid Afridi, Ijaz Ahmed, Salim Malik, Inzamam-ul-Haq, Moin Khan, Abdul Razzak, Saqlain Mushtaq, Mohammed Hussain, Aaqib Javed.

Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Roshan Mahanama, Marvan Atapattu, Aravinda De Silva, Hashan Tillekeratne, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Kumara Dharmasena, Duleep Liyanage, Sajeeva De Silva, Muthiah Muralitharan.
